filament_moduleplugins: PHP file defining ModulePlugins, the host class that composes Filament panel plugins from enabled modules' manifests.
finding_jetstream_bridge_types: Code-conformance audit finding (docs/CODE-CONFORMANCE.md) that seven packages call members not present on the type they are declared against.
finding_livewire_aliases: Code-conformance audit finding (docs/CODE-CONFORMANCE.md) that Livewire component aliases registered by modules are not namespaced/package-qualified, risking collisions such as with LanguageSwitcher.
finding_missing_context_docs: Code-conformance audit finding (docs/CODE-CONFORMANCE.md) that CLAUDE.md describes a per-package domain-doc layout that does not actually exist in the repository.
finding_service_locator: Code-conformance audit finding (docs/CODE-CONFORMANCE.md) that the codebase prohibits the service-locator pattern but has no enforcing rule, and the prohibition is violated.
finding_strict_types: Code-conformance audit finding (docs/CODE-CONFORMANCE.md) that declare(strict_types=1) is absent from almost every PHP file in the fleet.
fixtures_organizationuser: PHP file defining OrganizationUser, a test fixture model used by organizations-teams-filament's test suite.
fixtures_organizationuser_organizationus: .belongsToTeam(), a test-fixture method on OrganizationUser checking whether the user is a member of a given team.
.ownsTeam(), a test-fixture method on OrganizationUser checking whether the user owns a given team.
fixtures_roleduser: PHP file defining RoledUser, a test fixture model with role assignments used by identity-core-filament's test suite.
fixtures_searchableuser: PHP file defining SearchableUser, a test fixture model implementing the search module's searchable contract.
fixtures_testpanelprovider: PHP file defining TestPanelProvider, a minimal Filament panel provider fixture used by settings-filament's tests.
fixtures_testpanelprovider_testpanelprov: TestPanelProvider, a test-fixture Filament panel provider whose .panel() method configures a bare panel for settings-filament's test suite.
formatting_localeformatter: PHP file defining LocaleFormatter, a service in the localization-core module for locale-aware value formatting.
fortify_createnewuser: PHP file defining CreateNewUser, the Fortify action in jetstream-bridge that validates and creates a new registered user.
fortify_updateuserprofileinformation: PHP file defining UpdateUserProfileInformation, the Fortify action in jetstream-bridge that updates a user's profile information.
fortify_updateuserprofileinformation_upd: .update(), the UpdateUserProfileInformation method that validates and applies profile field changes to a user.
.updateVerifiedUser(), the UpdateUserProfileInformation method that updates an already-verified user's profile, resetting verification if the email changed.
four_implementation_indexes: Four Implementation Indexes (core / api / filament / livewire), the documented index structure in projects/LIBERU.md organizing each domain module by its adapter tier.
health_readinessregistry: PHP file defining ReadinessRegistry, a service in the application module that tracks readiness checks for the /up health endpoint.
health_readinessregistry_readinessregist: .ready(), the ReadinessRegistry method that reports whether all registered readiness checks currently pass.
.report(), the ReadinessRegistry method that returns a detailed report of each registered readiness check's status.
identity_core_module: Liberu Identity, the core module providing user identity primitives, referenced by the Liberu Profiles module's shared users table extension.
installation_does_not_imply_enablement: Documented principle (in activity-comments' README, restated from CLAUDE.md) that installing a module package does not automatically enable/boot it; enablement is a separate explicit decision.
jetstream_deleteuser: PHP file defining DeleteUser, the Jetstream action in jetstream-bridge that deletes a user account.
jetstream_deleteuser_deleteuser_delete: .delete(), the DeleteUser action method that deletes the given user's account.
jetstream_deleteuser_deleteuser_deletete: .deleteTeams(), the DeleteUser action method that deletes the teams owned by a user being removed.
laravel_jetstream: laravel/jetstream, the Laravel package providing team management and profile UI scaffolding used by the organizations-teams module.
laravel_pulse: laravel/pulse, the Laravel application performance monitoring package used by the observability module.
laravel_telescope: laravel/telescope, the Laravel debugging and introspection package used by the observability module.
layouts_app_blade: app.blade.php, the base Blade layout template for the real-estate-default theme.
letting_lifecycle: Letting Lifecycle Capabilities, documentation in the real-estate-lettings README describing the state transitions a letting record can go through.
lettings_livewire_specification: Lettings Livewire Specification, documentation in the real-estate-lettings README describing the Livewire adapter built on the matching core package.
listeners_emitauthenticationevent: PHP file defining EmitAuthenticationEvent, an event listener in the identity-core module.
listeners_emitauthenticationevent_emitau: EmitAuthenticationEvent, a listener class whose .handle() method emits an authentication-related event.
livewire_languageswitcher: PHP file defining LanguageSwitcher, the localization-core-livewire component for switching the active site locale.
livewire_themeswitcher: PHP file defining ThemeSwitcher, the theme-support-livewire component for switching the active site theme.
